**Pre-check finding:** Before this fix, `/find-legal-help` (App.tsx:93) had exactly one inbound link — inside `LEGAL_AID_LINKS` (`caselaw/types.ts:87`), rendered only within `CaseLawLookupFL.tsx`'s disclaimer section, not from HomeHub or the Navbar. No footer component exists in the repo (only `Navbar.jsx`, which has just Home/Upload/Dashboard). `/attorney-referral` (App.tsx:92) is in the identical situation — same `LEGAL_AID_LINKS` entry, no HomeHub tile, no nav entry. Per scope, I did not touch `/attorney-referral`; logged it in `FOLLOW_UPS.md` as belonging to S2-1.

**Fix:** Added one tile to `HomeHub.tsx`'s `MODULE_TILES` array — `{ title: "Find Legal Help", subtitle: "Free legal aid by county", to: "/find-legal-help", icon: "🤝" }` — matching the existing tile style/format exactly (no new styles introduced).

**Verification:** `npm run build` in `frontend/` completed with no errors (1841 modules transformed, built in 993ms; only pre-existing chunk-size warning, unrelated).

**Summary:** `/find-legal-help` was built and routed but had no discoverable entry point from the home hub — a user landing on HomeHub could never reach it except by stumbling into the Case Law Lookup page's disclaimer text. The fix adds a standard HomeHub tile (same `HubTile` component, same data shape as the other 12 tiles), a one-line, additive change. Regression risk is minimal: it only appends to an existing array rendered via `.map()`, so it can't affect other tiles' rendering; worst case is a purely cosmetic 13th-tile layout wrap on narrow viewports, which the existing `auto-fit` grid CSS already handles.
